chunks: "Did you do this to our gods, O Abraham?" they enquired.

key_terms.آلِهَتِنَا: Our gods (plural of ilah, referring to the idols)

ai.seo_question: What did the polytheists ask Prophet Ibrahim after he broke their idols?
ai.summary: In this pivotal moment of confrontation, the polytheists directly accuse Ibrahim (peace be upon him) of destroying their idols, marking the climax of his theological debate with his people. This verse underscores the shift from quiet preaching to public demonstration of monotheism, a key theme in Shia exegesis regarding the Prophet's authority and the rejection of idolatry.
